Game Overview

Among Yetto Bots is a adventure title where embark on a thrilling adventure in a 2D sci-fi world, mastering your platformer skills against advanced enemy bots and perilous traps. Conquer eight challenging levels, collect golden balls, and strategically use double jumps to outmaneuver threats and reach new heights. Can you secure the ultimate victory?
